context: Kenji advises Ren on a cautious work decision.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: work chat; adverbs (むしろ/それでも/一応/おそらく/少なくとも) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この案、進めて大丈夫でしょうか?
lines.en: Is it okay to go ahead with this plan?
lines.style: cautious young colleague voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: むしろ、慎重に進めた方がいいですよ。
lines.en: Rather, it's better to proceed carefully.
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それでも、締め切りは迫っています。
lines.en: Even so, the deadline is near.
lines.style: concerned young colleague voice, soft warm earnest throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一応、上司に確認しておきましょう。
lines.en: Let's check with the boss just in case.
lines.style: helpful office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おそらく、許可は下りますよね?
lines.style: hopeful young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 少なくとも、相談する価値はあります。
lines.style: measured office man voice, soft warm guiding throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それでも、不安は残りますね。
lines.style: honest young colleague voice, soft warm throughout

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: むしろ、その慎重さが大事ですよ。
lines.style: warm office man voice, soft warm closing throughout
